courses.name: Kisaragi Dock Loop
courses.sectorsBrief: Container-yard switchback; broad freight-apron carousel; elevated loading-ramp crest; waterfront braking zone
courses.designNote: Supports Circuit, Drift Attack zones and Time Attack. No shipping traffic, pedestrians or borrowed logos. Initial authoring target (3.4 km per lap).

courses.name: Hoshino Switchback Park
courses.formatDescription: Uphill sprint on a former service road
courses.sectorsBrief: Linked medium-radius uphill bends; short tunnel; technical five-hairpin climb; fast final ridge
courses.designNote: Supports Sprint, selected drift zones and Time Attack. Believable grading, barriers and safe runoff. Initial authoring target.

courses.name: Aobane Airfield Circuit
courses.formatDescription: Two-lap circuit at a closed regional airfield
courses.sectorsBrief: Runway braking zones; taxiway technical esses; banked maintenance-road turn; hangar-perimeter sequence
courses.designNote: Supports Circuit, large drift zones and Time Attack. Not cones on an empty plane. Initial authoring target (4.3 km per lap).

access.priceBasis: Initial reference ~9,000 Credits per ordinary completed race (≈5/6/7 races for FP01/02/03). Balancing assumption, not measured economy evidence.
